customers_say: Customers find the water purifier reliable and appreciate its premium appearance, with one noting it's suitable for a family of 4 to 5 people. The product is easy to use, has good installation, and produces clean, pure water that tastes good. While some customers report prompt service, others find the customer support extremely disappointing.

reviews.title: Good quality product
reviews.body: Product is very good. I see that water is filtered 40tdm from 215tdm. I am happy with product. I an using for municipal and bore water. Happy to purchase and recommended to this.

reviews.author: Rajkumar Yaduwanshi
reviews.title: Good Product and Satisfactory Performance
reviews.body: The RO water purifier is working well and provides clean, good-tasting water. The design is nice, and it is easy to use. Overall, I am satisfied with the product and would recommend it to others.

reviews.author: sangram keshari dash
reviews.title: Very dissatisfied
reviews.body: I purchased this Aquaguard water purifier from Amazon expecting clean and pure drinking water. However, after installation, the technician informed me that I needed to install an additional iron filter, which would cost ₹2,100 extra. If I am purchasing a water purifier, I expect to know about such additional requirements and costs beforehand, not after the product has been delivered and installed. Why should I have to pay extra just to make the purifier suitable for my water? This experience has been extremely disappointing.
